name: Lazarus
summary: A man of Bethany, brother of Martha and Mary, whom Jesus loved. After he had been dead four days, Jesus called him out of the tomb alive.

key_moments.title: Falls Sick in Bethany
key_moments.description: Lazarus of Bethany fell sick, and his sisters sent word to Jesus that the one He loved was sick. Jesus said this sickness would bring glory to God, and He stayed where He was two more days.

key_moments.title: Raised from the Dead
key_moments.description: At the tomb, a cave with a stone over it, Jesus had the stone taken away, thanked His Father, and called loudly for Lazarus to come out. Lazarus came out still wrapped in grave clothes, and Jesus told them to unbind him and let him go.

key_moments.title: Plotted Against by the Chief Priests
key_moments.description: Crowds came to see Lazarus, the man Jesus had brought back from death. Because many came to believe in Jesus on his account, the chief priests planned to kill Lazarus too.
